summary: All 13 hard checks passed, but the agent wrote final.md to ws/merchants/casa-verde-es/final.md instead of the run directory (FINAL_EXISTS=false), even though its closing note claimed the correct path; the rubric was judged on that misplaced copy, which meets every item.
